6190-northern-lights-volume-5.creator: Gilbert Parker
6190-northern-lights-volume-5.description: A book by Gilbert Parker. l-head on the Canadian Pacific Railroad. Forty miles from Kowatin he had been caught by, and escaped from, the tall, brown-eyed man with the hard-bitten face who leaned against the open window of the tavern, looking indifferently at the jeering crowd before him.

arxiv-2004-12274.title: Show, Describe and Conclude: On Exploiting the Structure Information of Chest X-Ray Reports
arxiv-2004-12274.creator: Baoyu Jing, Zeya Wang, Eric Xing
arxiv-2004-12274.description: Abstract Chest X-Ray (CXR) images are commonly used for clinical screening and diagnosis. Automatically writing reports for these images can considerably lighten the workload of radiologists for summarizing descriptive findings and conclusive impressions. The complex structures between and within sections of the reports pose a great challenge to the automatic report generation.

arxiv-2101-04556.title: Masking Host Identity on Internet: Encrypted TLS/SSL Handshake
arxiv-2101-04556.creator: Vinod S. Khandkar and Manjesh K. Hanawal
arxiv-2101-04556.description: Abstract Network middle-boxes often classify the traffic flows on the Internet to perform traffic management or discriminate one traffic against the other. As the widespread adoption of HTTPS protocol has made it difficult to classify the traffic looking into the content field, one of the fields the middle-boxes look for is Server Name Indicator (SNI), which goes in plain text.

arxiv-2107-03674.title: Inference and forecasting for continuous-time integer-valued trawl processes
arxiv-2107-03674.creator: Mikkel Bennedsen, Asger Lunde, Neil Shephard, Almut E. D. Veraart
arxiv-2107-03674.description: Abstract This paper develops likelihood-based methods for estimation, inference, model selection, and forecasting of continuous-time integer-valued trawl processes. The full likelihood of integer-valued trawl processes is, in general, highly intractable, motivating the use of composite likelihood methods, where we consider the pairwise likelihood in lieu of the full likelihood.

arxiv-2112-13956.title: A Blockchain-based Data Governance Framework with Privacy Protection and Provenance for e-Prescription
arxiv-2112-13956.creator: Rodrigo Dutra Garcia 1 , Gowri Sankar Ramachandran 2 , Raja Jurdak 2 , and Jo Ueyama 1
arxiv-2112-13956.description: Abstract Real-world applications in healthcare and supply chain domains produce, exchange, and share data in a multi-stakeholder environment. Data owners want to control their data and privacy in such settings. On the other hand, data consumers demand methods to understand when, how, and who produced the data.

arxiv-2206-08628.title: The Wavefront Sets of Unipotent Supercuspidal Representations
arxiv-2206-08628.creator: Dan Ciubotaru, Lucas Mason-Brown, Emile Okada
arxiv-2206-08628.description: Abstract Let 𝐆 ⁡ ( 𝗄 ) \mathbf{G}({\mathsf{k}}) be a semisimple p p -adic group, inner to split. In this article, we compute the algebraic and canonical unramified wavefront sets of the irreducible supercuspidal representations of 𝐆 ⁡ ( 𝗄 ) \mathbf{G}({\mathsf{k}}) in Lusztig’s category of unipotent representations.

arxiv-2210-09789.title: Anti-Symmetric DGN: a stable architecture for Deep Graph Networks
arxiv-2210-09789.creator: Alessio Gravina, Davide Bacciu, Claudio Gallicchio
arxiv-2210-09789.description: Abstract Deep Graph Networks (DGNs) currently dominate the research landscape of learning from graphs, due to their efficiency and ability to implement an adaptive message-passing scheme between the nodes. However, DGNs are typically limited in their ability to propagate and preserve long-term dependencies between nodes, i.e., they suffer from the over-squashing phenomena.

arxiv-2306-11447.title: Transparency in App Analytics: Analyzing the Collection of User Interaction Data Thanks: *This paper has been accepted at the 20th Annual International Conference on Privacy, Security & Trust (PST2023)
arxiv-2306-11447.creator: Feiyang Tang, Bjarte M. Østvold
arxiv-2306-11447.description: Abstract The rise of mobile apps has brought greater convenience and many options for users. However, many apps use analytics services to collect a wide range of user interaction data, with privacy policies often failing to reveal the types of interaction data collected or the extent of the data collection practices.

arxiv-2309-13521.title: JWST MIRI and NIRCam Unveil Previously Unseen Infrared Stellar Populations in NGC 6822 2024 JWST MIRI and NIRCam Unveil Previously Unseen Infrared Stellar Populations in NGC 6822 – 7
arxiv-2309-13521.creator: Conor Nally, Olivia C. Jones, Laura Lenkić, Nolan Habel, Alec S. Hirschauer , Margaret Meixner , P. J. Kavanagh , Martha L. Boyer , Annette M. N. Ferguson , B. A. Sargent , Omnarayani Nayak and Tea Temim
arxiv-2309-13521.description: Abstract NGC 6822 is a nearby ( ∼ \sim 490 kpc) non-interacting low-metallicity (0.2 Z ⊙ Z_{\odot} ) dwarf galaxy which hosts several prominent H ii regions, including sites of highly embedded active star formation. In this work, we present an imaging survey of NGC 6822 conducted with the NIRCam and MIRI instruments onboard JWST.

This work utilized the following tools: astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2

arxiv-2309-14407.description: Abstract We present 500 AU and 700 AU resolution 1 mm and 3 mm ALMA observations, respectively, of protostellar cores in protoclusters Sagittarius B2 (Sgr B2) North (N) and Main (M), parts of the most actively star-forming cloud in our Galaxy.

arxiv-2404-00585.title: Openness of the frame set on the hyperbolas
arxiv-2404-00585.creator: Aleksei Kulikov
arxiv-2404-00585.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aleksei Kulikov. We prove that for the functions of the form g ⁡ ( x ) = h ⁡ ( x ) + C x + i g(x)=h(x)+\frac{C}{x+i} , where h h belongs to the continuous Wiener algebra W 0 W_{0} , the intersection of the frame set ℱ g \mathcal{F}_{g} with every hyperbola { α , β > 0 ∣ α β = c } \{\alpha,\beta>0\mid\alpha\beta=c\} is open in the relative topology. In particular, this applies to all rational functions g g .

arxiv-2407-09170.title: Linear waves on the expanding region of Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetimes: forward asymptotics and scattering from infinity
arxiv-2407-09170.creator: Louie Bernhardt
arxiv-2407-09170.description: Abstract We study solutions to the linear wave equation on the cosmological region of Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetimes. We show that all sufficiently regular finite-energy solutions to the linear equation possess a particular finite-order asymptotic expansion near the future boundary. Specifically, we prove that several terms in this asymptotic expansion are identically zero.

pmc-10528841.title: A Clinical Approach of Allergic Rhinitis in Children
pmc-10528841.creator: Ioannis Goniotakis, Evanthia Perikleous, Sotirios Fouzas, Paschalis Steiropoulos, Emmanouil Paraskakis, Bo Chawes
pmc-10528841.description: Allergic rhinitis is an important disease with a global footprint and a growing prevalence, affecting children and adults. Although it is commonly under-diagnosed and under-treated, it causes important social and economic effects (diminished quality of life, poor academic performance, escalated medical visits, heightened medication usage, and effects in other chronic conditions, e.g., asthma).

pmc-11358001.title: Titin governs myocardial passive stiffness with major support from microtubules and actin and the extracellular matrix
pmc-11358001.creator: Christine M Loescher, Johanna K Freundt, Andreas Unger, Anthony L Hessel, Michel Kühn, Franziska Koser, Wolfgang A Linke
pmc-11358001.description: Myocardial passive stiffness is crucial for the heart’s pump function and is determined by mechanical elements, including the extracellular matrix and cytoskeletal filaments; however, their individual contributions are controversially discussed and difficult to quantify. In this study, we targeted the cytoskeletal filaments in a mouse model, which enables the specific, acute and complete cleavage of the sarcomeric titin springs.

pmc-11417755.title: Chikungunya-Driven Gene Expression Linked to Osteoclast Survival and Chronic Arthralgia
pmc-11417755.creator: Alysson Henrique Urbanski, Vanessa E Maso, Felipe M Martins, André Guilherme da Costa-Martins, Ana Paula B do Nascimento Oliveira, Helder I Nakaya, Alessandro Bartoloni
pmc-11417755.description: Chikungunya fever (CHIKF), caused by the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), manifests as acute febrile illness often associated with polyarthritis and polyarthralgia. Although the acute symptoms resolve within two weeks, many patients experience prolonged joint pain and inflammation, resembling rheumatoid arthritis (RA).

pmc-11577145.title: Comparison of Bromelain and Diclofenac in the Management of Postoperative Pain and Quality of Life Following Root Canal Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11577145.creator: Akbarbasha Sherin, Subha Anirudhan, Minu Koshy
pmc-11577145.description: AimThis study aimed to compare the analgesic efficacy and adverse effects of oral bromelain and diclofenac in relieving postoperative pain and improving postoperative quality of life in patients with irreversible pulpitis in mandibular first molars after root canal therapy.Materials and methodsA simple randomized double-blinded clinical trial was carried out.

pmc-11620229.title: The impact of supervised and home exercise activity intervention on circulating immune cell numbers in cancer patients
pmc-11620229.creator: Rihacek Michal, Wagnerova Andrea, Halamkova Jana, Pehalova Lucie, Rihackova Eva, Boucek Lubos, Kapounková Kateřina, Hrnčiříková Iva, Kiss Igor
pmc-11620229.description: IntroductionMalignant diseases challenge clinicians to balance treatment intensity and patient quality of life. Regular physical activity positively impacts mental and physical health, benefiting sleep patterns, heart rate, and overall health. Moreover, telehealth physical exercise training represents a viable option for maintaining intrinsic capacity. The American Cancer Society highlights exercise's role in helping patients cope with anti-cancer treatment side effects.

pmc-12631215.title: Case Report: Novel compound heterozygous mutations in PNPLA6 gene associated with Oliver-McFarlane syndrome
pmc-12631215.creator: Jia Zheng, Zhe Wang, Keqing Li, Lixia Chen, Yayin Luo, Fei Yu, Dan Wang, Guangxiang Yu
pmc-12631215.description: BackgroundOliver-McFarlane syndrome (OMCS) is an extremely rare congenital disorder that presents with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, long eyelashes and eyebrows, pigmentary retinopathy, peripheral nerve axon neuropathy and other associated features. It is currently known that OMCS is linked to variants in the patatin-like phospholipase domain containing 6 (PNPLA6) gene, but the specific pathogenic mechanism is still unclear.

pmc-12639682.title: Pollination as a biocultural process: integrating local ecological knowledge of family farmers in northern Argentinian Patagonia for inclusive conservation
pmc-12639682.creator: Pablo Andres Grimaldi, Ana Ladio
pmc-12639682.description: BackgroundPollination is a complex and biocultural significant ecological process, essential for the reproduction of cultivated and wild plants. In family farming, pollination is crucial due to the economic and cultural dependence on pollinators. This study examines local ecological knowledge about pollination in three localities of northern Patagonia, Argentina.

pmc-12712026.title: Effects of diaphragmatic breathing training on alarm fatigue and patient safety culture among ICU nurses: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-12712026.creator: Sirous Pourkhajoei, Fatemeh Najarzadeh Riseh, Neda Asadi
pmc-12712026.description: Background and aim Alarms in ICUs are a major factor in causing fatigue in nurses. This can lead to a decrease in the quality of nursing care and patient safety culture. This study aimed to investigate the effect of diaphragmatic breathing training on Alarm fatigue and patient safety culture from the perspective of intensive care unit nurses.

pmc-12837080.title: Effectiveness and safety of suction-assisted versus traditional access sheaths in minimally invasive percutaneous nephrolithotomy: a meta-analysis of 10 randomized trials
pmc-12837080.creator: Yulong Li, Zhongbao Zhou, Yong Zhang, Huantao Zong
pmc-12837080.description: ObjectiveTo systematically evaluate the effectiveness and safety of suction-assisted sheaths (SAS) compared to traditional access sheaths (TAS) in minimally invasive percutaneous nephrolithotomy (MPCNL) for renal calculi—addressing key limitations of MPCNL such as compromised irrigation outflow, intraoperative elevation of intrarenal pressure (IRP), and the associated risk of infectious complications.

pmc-13436877.title: Asystole during laryngoscopy with a videolaryngoscope in a patient with an anticipated difficult airway: A case report
pmc-13436877.creator: Ryosuke Osawa, Naoi Tsurumachi, Yohei Tamura, Takero Arai
pmc-13436877.description: Asystole during tracheal intubation using a direct laryngoscope has been reported, but there has been no report of asystole during tracheal intubation using a videolaryngoscope. We report a case of asystole during videolaryngoscopy in a 76-year-old woman with marked tracheal deviation caused by a large thyroid adenoma. General anesthesia was induced with remimazolam 6 mg/kg/h, fentanyl 0.

pmc-13663042.title: Genetic evidence for a potential role of cytoskeleton-associated protein 2 in lung squamous cell carcinoma: a bidirectional mendelian randomization study
pmc-13663042.creator: Qiang Xie, Yuzuo Lin, Qingtong Wu, Ziyan Lin, Yanhong Cheng, Guodong Zhong, Lei Wang
pmc-13663042.description: BackgroundCytoskeleton-associated protein 2 (CKAP2) plays a role in tumor proliferation, but its causal relationship with lung cancer remains unclear. This study employed a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis to investigate this association.MethodsUsing genome-wide association and FinnGen data, we assessed the potential causal relationship between genetically predicted plasma CKAP2 levels and lung cancer risk, including its subtypes.
